agent.problem: The second blank asks for wording the baker cannot yet reason out. The preceding card supports “evil” through the hostile witnesses and their charges, but no earlier card says David repaid these people with “good”; his care for them is not introduced until the next card.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
